result.summary: Wrote lit.md for seed 803 / round 1, covering the 4 literature topics from analysis.md's closing section (intraday volume timing / order-imbalance proxies without tick data / Roll-type spread estimators vs price-level confounds / post-neutralization residual predictability and newly-listed-stock contamination). Used WebSearch+WebFetch (loaded via ToolSearch) to find and verify 16 pre-2023-08-08 academic sources (Admati-Pfleiderer 1988, Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka 2010, Gao-Han-Li-Zhou 2018, Chen-Liu-Teka-Zhang 2022 China A-share smart money, Lee-Ready 1991, Easley-Lopez de Prado-O'Hara VPIN 2012, Andersen-Bondarenko 2013 VPIN critique, Chordia-Subrahmanyam 2004, Chordia-Subrahmanyam-Anshuman 2001, Hasbrouck 2009, Roll 1984, Corwin-Schultz 2012, Abdi-Ranaldo 2017, Goyenko-Holden-Trzcinka 2009, Amihud 2002, Liu-Stambaugh-Yuan 2019 Size and Value in China), each with full citation fields and verified:true (confirmed via direct WebFetch of the source page or concrete bibliographic detail surfaced in WebSearch results). Each topic section distills literature treatments into operator-language processing recipes (e.g., Roll's undefined-covariance-case handling mapped to the day_es_ratio_hi epsilon bug already flagged in analysis.md; Corwin-Schultz's 1-day-vs-2-day range scaling mapped to the existing window-doubling sensitivity check; VPIN's bulk volume classification mapped to a smoother alternative for day_signed_ratio; Liu-Stambaugh-Yuan's bottom-30%-by-size shell-value exclusion mapped to the newly-listed-stock contamination question), with per-item citations. Searches that failed to turn up a verifiable pre-cutoff source (e.g. the original 2017 东方证券 聪明钱因子 report, an A-share listing-age-day-count exclusion rule, a named "volume centroid" academic literature, suspension-sample handling methodology) are explicitly listed as "搜不到、不采用" rather than fabricated. File written via Write tool and confirmed on disk with ls -l (22,592 bytes).
